Classification systems known to soilKey

Source: R/systems-registry.R
soilkey_systems.Rd

Lists the classification systems registered in the package, one row per system, in the order classify_all runs them. Each system is a folder inst/rules/<id>/ holding its key and a system.yaml entry. The id is what load_rules and classify_all accept; the aliases are accepted too.

Usage

soilkey_systems()

Value

A data.frame with one row per system and the columns id, name (English display name), edition, status, classifier (the function that classifies a PedonRecord in that system), levels and aliases (both comma-separated), and default (whether classify_all(systems = "all") runs the system).

See also

classify_all, load_rules.

Examples

soilkey_systems()
#>        id                                                name
#> 1 wrb2022                                            WRB 2022
#> 2  sibcs5                                  SiBCS, 5th edition
#> 3    usda                                  USDA Soil Taxonomy
#> 4   cssc3 Canadian System of Soil Classification, 3rd edition
#> 5    asc3         Australian Soil Classification, 3rd edition
#>                                                         edition       status
#> 1                                            4th edition (2022)       stable
#> 2                                            5th edition (2018)       stable
#> 3                                           13th edition (2022)       stable
#> 4                                            3rd edition (1998) experimental
#> 5 3rd edition (2021), online version with errata (25 June 2026) experimental
#>         classifier                                       levels aliases default
#> 1 classify_wrb2022                                         rsgs     wrb    TRUE
#> 2   classify_sibcs ordens, subordens, grandes_grupos, subgrupos   sibcs    TRUE
#> 3    classify_usda   orders, suborders, great_groups, subgroups            TRUE
#> 4   classify_cssc3              orders, great_groups, subgroups    cssc   FALSE
#> 5    classify_asc3   orders, suborders, great_groups, subgroups     asc   FALSE
